text:
Type: checked woven cushion
Use: comfort and pattern on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, retro
Materials: woven cotton with a fine twill texture
Colors: dark chocolate brown, warm beige, cream, black, grey
Shape: square plump cushion with an irregular checkerboard pattern of small blocks in earthy tones, softly rounded corners, medium size
Feel: warm, earthy, graphic, cozy
Goes with: brown leather, walnut or teak wood, cream or grey sofas; mid-century modern or retro living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
